1 · Flight replay 2 · Sounding 3 · Wind tower

Two balloons, one chase. The flight paths are true scale over USGS aerial imagery: one grid square is 5 miles, and the balloons climb 16 miles over a 29 mile drift. The balloons and van are enlarged so you can see them. Drag to orbit, scroll to zoom.

Imagery: USDA, USGS The National Map

3D view needs WebGL, which this browser did not provide. The Sounding tab works without it.
06:50:00 AM

What the atmosphere looked like on the way up. Each panel shares the same altitude axis, so read across. The air cools until about 63,000 ft, then warms again in the stratosphere. Pressure falls to under 2% of sea level at burst. Hover to read any altitude.

Table view (ascent, every 10,000 ft)
